description: Make sounds in a Game kit: each sound gets up to four takes, and each sound made is one generation. Each uses one of the account's generations of the day, shared with generate_sound: 3 free, or its plan's. Nothing is charged. When none is left it answers with plans_url: the user chooses a plan on that page (from $9.90 for 30 days: 50 to 200 generations a day for the whole account), never the agent.

sound_ids.description: Sounds to make or remake (default: every listed sound not made yet).

name: make_kit_sounds
